interest: Shows Japan's global 1930s search for naval fuel, including Soviet oil talks, London discussions, and Mexican tanker shipments via Panama.
overview: Docket (1932-34) on Japanese naval fuel procurement: a Matsukata-promoted Russo-Japanese oil deal, London oil talks, Mexican fuel shipments via the Husisan Maru, and Mexico-Chile diplomatic inquiries.

people.name: Kojiro Matsukata
people.role: Japanese industrialist and promoter of Russo-Japanese petroleum agreement

people.name: Herschel V. Johnson
people.role: U.S. Chargé d'Affaires in Great Britain
